mapping.summary: Toolkit adding custom fields, configurable layouts, data sync and production reporting.
claims: Up to 20 custom fields on supported master and transaction tables
Custom fields support types, options, table relations, mandatory flags and transfer to related documents
Document layouts configured without development, with placeholders and multilingual texts
Static and conditional content on invoices, confirmations and delivery notes
Structured quotes with numbering, headings, subtotals and page breaks
Syncs data across companies and separate BC databases via field mappings
Shipping monitor of open sales orders with stock, purchase, shipment and production demand
Creates warehouse shipments from the shipping monitor
Fast posting of production time, output and component scrap
Reopen finished production orders for correction
Batch-finish released production orders by criteria
Production orders reference the sales order
Default period grouping for Item Availability by Event
